step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram displays a cross-account machine learning deployment workflow (EXAMT/XAMD) across three accounts: Data Science, QA, and Production. Data Scientists approve models in the SageMaker Model Registry. ML Engineers use EXAMT APIs to orchestrate deployment from Model Registry to QA SageMaker Endpoint, then to Production Endpoint. Mobile clients interact directly with the Production SageMaker Endpoint for predictions.
